cap.tr: Bir obek (heap), en kucuk (ya da en buyuk) degeri her zaman kokte tutan tam bir agactir. Burada bir min-obek: her dugum, cocuklarindan kucuk esit. Diziye 5, 3, 8, 1, 9, 2 degerlerini SIRAYLA ekleyecegiz.
cap.en: A heap is a complete tree that always keeps the smallest (or largest) value at the root. Here, a min-heap: every node is less than or equal to its children. We will insert 5, 3, 8, 1, 9, 2 one at a time.
